run_generate_embeddings_dataset: run generate_embeddings_dataset to pre-compute embeddings for a dataset using a convolutional encoder
create_embeddings_dataset_cuda: create an embeddings dataset from wav tensors using GPU acceleration and a specified batch size
build_parallel_embeddings_dataset: build an embeddings dataset with multi-GPU parallel encoding via nn.DataParallel
test_generate_embeddings_dataset: test generate_embeddings_dataset with a mock dataset and encoder to verify embedding output
summarize_generate_embeddings_dataset: summarize generate_embeddings_dataset which replaces wav tensors with encoder embeddings in a dataset
